description: Na₃MgMo(OF)₃ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to three O and three F atoms to form distorted NaO₃F₃ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent MgO₃F₃ octahedra, edges with three equivalent NaO₃F₃ octahedra, and  a faceface with one MgO₃F₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-36°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.61 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.37 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to three O and three F atoms to form distorted NaO₃F₃ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent MgO₃F₃ octahedra, edges with three equivalent NaO₃F₃ octahedra, and  a faceface with one MgO₃F₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-52°. There is one shorter (2.39 Å) and two longer (2.40 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.66 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three O and three F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.71 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.29 Å. Mg is bonded to three O and three F atoms to form MgO₃F₃ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₃F₃ octahedra and faces with two NaO₃F₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-52°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.13 Å. There are a spread of Mg-F bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.16 Å. Mo is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-1.94 Å. There is one shorter (2.26 Å) and one longer (2.70 Å) Mo-F bond length. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Mo atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one Mo atom to form distorted ONa₃MgMo trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one FNa₃MgMo trigonal bipyramid and edges with two equivalent FNa₃MgMo trigonal bipyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Mo atom. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Mo atom. In the second F site, F is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one Mo atom to form distorted FNa₃MgMo trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃MgMo trigonal bipyramid and edges with two equivalent ONa₃MgMo trigonal bipyramids. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Mg atom.
